title: CleanCodeGatesSelect
description: What `gates.cjs select` writes to <out>/select.json: the tests (and live flows) a change selects, each with the reasons it was selected. Every array is sorted by code unit.

mode.description: tier: the selection block of a change-selected barrier tier (--tier). adhoc: --tests/--sources/--by/--max.

change.description: invalid: the working tree's config is broken (key `config`), so its additions are ignored and the base's instruments run.

status.description: red when the selection exceeds max, else pass. A usage or config error exits 3 and writes no report.

changed.description: Every file that differs between the base and the working tree, deleted and untracked files included.

within_max.description: null when no max is declared.

whole.description: true when a changed file matches the tier's select.whole_on: every test is selected, reason `whole_on <glob>`.

reasons.description: At most eight, route reasons first (by method, then path), then the rest by code unit: `route <METHOD> <path> (<controller>:<line>[ at base]) → … (changed|deleted) · called at <test>:<line>`, `changed <test>`, `imports <test>:<line> → … → <file> (changed|deleted)`, `whole_on <glob>`, or `wired by <module> → … → <file> (changed|deleted)`.

unresolved.description: Import specifiers that resolve nowhere in the tests' dependency closure (a workspace package's name included), plus path templates whose leading ${NAME} names no same-file constant.

unmapped.description: Changed files under the tier's cwd that are no import-graph node and match no tests, sources or whole_on glob: nothing proves them inert. Sorted.

flows.description: With --flows: the live-block flows whose paths match a changed file. Empty otherwise.
